messages:
Priya K: FYI postmortem for INC-426 posted. We need action owners for noise reduction, and to lock ETA for dedupe + threshold changes. Who can take what?
Jorge: Ill own the paging-policy changes. Plan to propose policy doc + ACL list.
Aisha: Ill handle metric-level thresholds for the cache/redis alerts. Will run spike analysis to pick safe percentiles.
Priya K: @Jorge include simulation results for paging volume before/after.
Jorge: Will do. Simulation script in infra/sim/alerts-sim.py, results by Wed.
Platform Bot: New ticket created: PMT-983 "paging policy rewrite" assigned to Jorge.
Aisha: For thresholds, thinking: use 95th for prod-window, fallback to 98th for burst windows, and require sustained >3min before paging. Ill validate against last 30d.
Priya K: Good. Add rollback plan if noise goes up post-change.
Jorge: One question  do we want dedupe to group by host or by region? current rule groups by host which triggers pages across many hosts.
Aisha: Region is safer for our multi-AZ pattern. Host-level dedupe causes thundering.
Priya K: Switch to region grouping for dedupe; keep host-grouping for critical alerts only. Add exception list.
Jorge: noted. Will add exception list and migration steps.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: runbook review scheduled 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC in #postmortems.
Priya K: Timeline recap: Jorge  paging policy doc + sim results by Wed; Aisha  threshold analysis by Thu; I'll write rollback clause and update postmortem tracker.
Aisha: Ill also add sample dashboards showing suppressed vs paged counts.
Jorge: PR draft created: https://git/redwood/infra/alerts/pulls/412. Adding reviewers.
Priya K: Thanks all. Once PR + analysis are linked in the tracker we can close this thread.
Platform Bot: Action tracker updated: PMT-983 assigned, due 2026-04-10.
